experimentalSettings.intro: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.
experimentalSettings.warning: Experimental features may break at any time.
experimentalSettings.warningDescription: These features are opt-in and come with no compatibility guarantees. They may change, break, or be removed without notice. Avoid relying on them for critical or production workflows.
experimentalSettings.featuresDescription: Optional product features that are still being evaluated.

enableAgentChat.title: Agent Chat
enableAgentChat.description: Talk to each agent in one ongoing conversation. Clarify goals and create tasks for execution.
enableAgentChat.footnote: Turning this off preserves conversations and lets active runs finish, but prevents new messages.

enableBetaSkills.title: Beta skills
enableBetaSkills.description: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.

enableBuiltInAgents.title: Built-in Agents
enableBuiltInAgents.description: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.

enableCases.title: Cases
enableCases.description: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
enableCases.footnote: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.

enableChatConnectors.title: Chat connectors
enableChatConnectors.description: Connect agents to Slack, GitHub, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram conversations.
enableChatConnectors.footnote: Turning this off hides chat setup, channels, and connected-task controls. Existing chat connections keep running. GitHub and other tool connectors stay available.

enableConferenceRoomChat.title: Conference Room Chat
enableConferenceRoomChat.description: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
enableConferenceRoomChat.ariaLabel: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting

enableDecisions.title: Decisions
enableDecisions.description: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.

enableEnvironments.title: Enable Environments
enableEnvironments.description: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.

enableExternalObjects.title: Enable External Objects
enableExternalObjects.description: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.

enableIsolatedWorkspaces.title: Enable Isolated Workspaces
enableIsolatedWorkspaces.description: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.

enableExperimentalFileViewer.title: Experimental File Viewer
enableExperimentalFileViewer.description: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.

enableFirstTaskPlanProposal.title: First task: propose with a plan document
enableFirstTaskPlanProposal.description: When the user's first request is a single task, the chief of staff writes a short plan document and a checkbox card instead of a one-card confirmation. Applies to organizations created after the toggle is flipped.
enableFirstTaskPlanProposal.ariaLabel: Toggle first task plan proposal experimental setting

enableMemoryConnectors.title: Memory connectors
enableMemoryConnectors.description: Connect Mem0, Zep, Supermemory, Cognee, and Honcho for long-term memory and context.
enableMemoryConnectors.footnote: Turning this off hides setup for these connectors. Existing connections keep running.

enableNativeRunner.title: Paperclip Runner
enableNativeRunner.description: Allow new Codex agents to select the experimental Rust Paperclip Runner, including authenticated runner ingress when a sandbox requires it. Onboarding continues to use legacy adapters. Turning this off hides the choice without affecting existing native runs.

enableSimplifiedEnglishInteractions.title: Simplified English Interactions
enableSimplifiedEnglishInteractions.description: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
enableSimplifiedEnglishInteractions.ariaLabel: Toggle simplified english interactions experimental setting

enableStatusCards.title: Status Cards
enableStatusCards.description: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
enableStatusCards.footnote: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.

enableStreamlinedUi.title: Streamlined UI
enableStreamlinedUi.description: Use the simplified main sidebar, shared Tasks and Inbox presentation, focused task detail layout, and contextual navigation across Agents, Routines, Skills, and Settings.
enableStreamlinedUi.footnote: Turning this off restores the legacy shell and navigation. Task and page data are unchanged.

enableSummaries.title: Summaries
enableSummaries.description: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
enableSummaries.footnote: Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabling Summaries also disables Status Cards.

enableIsolatedWorkspacesByDefault.title: Use Isolated Workspaces By Default
enableIsolatedWorkspacesByDefault.description: Treat a project that has no execution workspace policy of its own as if it selected isolated workspaces, so its tasks get a per-task worktree instead of sharing the project checkout. A project that carries its own policy keeps it.
enableIsolatedWorkspacesByDefault.ariaLabel: Toggle isolated workspaces by default experimental setting

experimentalSettings.developerDescription: Internal tools for developing, testing, and debugging Paperclip.

autoRestartDevServerWhenIdle.title: Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle
autoRestartDevServerWhenIdle.description: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.

enableManagedSandboxOnly.title: Managed Environment Only
enableManagedSandboxOnly.description: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed environment.
enableManagedSandboxOnly.ariaLabel: Toggle managed environment only experimental setting

enablePaperclipDeveloperMode.title: Paperclip Developer Mode
enablePaperclipDeveloperMode.description: Show internal Paperclip maintainer tools and observability links, including Honeycomb trace queries on run pages.
enablePaperclipDeveloperMode.ariaLabel: Toggle Paperclip developer mode experimental setting

experimentalSettings.worktreeDescription: This is an isolated git-worktree preview instance. Turn this on to let the scheduler execute runs here. Only tasks created after enabling will run automatically — copied/pre-existing tasks stay parked. Toggling off and on resets the cutoff.
experimentalSettings.mismatch: This setting was armed in a different instance and copied here, so no tasks run automatically.
experimentalSettings.missingCutoff: This setting is missing its activation cutoff, so no tasks run automatically.
experimentalSettings.rearm: Toggle it off and back on to arm execution for tasks created here.

enableServerInfoDebugView.title: Server Info Debug View
enableServerInfoDebugView.description: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
enableServerInfoDebugView.ariaLabel: Toggle server info debug view experimental setting

enableSmokeLab.title: Smoke Lab
enableSmokeLab.description: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.

enableIssuePlanDecompositions.title: Task Plan Decomposition
enableIssuePlanDecompositions.description: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
enableIssuePlanDecompositions.ariaLabel: Toggle task plan decomposition panel experimental setting

experimentalSettings.legacyDescription: These features are going to be removed.

enableClassicTaskInterface.title: Classic Task Interface
enableClassicTaskInterface.description: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features — streaming activity folding, inline plan and question cards, the three-mode composer — are unavailable in the classic view.
enableClassicTaskInterface.footnote: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.
enableClassicTaskInterface.ariaLabel: Toggle classic task interface experimental setting

enableGoalsSidebarLink.title: Goals Sidebar Link
enableGoalsSidebarLink.description: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
enableGoalsSidebarLink.ariaLabel: Toggle goals sidebar link experimental setting

taskUiFinalTail.retryError: Last attempt failed: {{error}}. Paperclip will retry automatically.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_not_visible_title: Task is outside this actor's visibility
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_not_visible_descripti: Issue writes are open by default, but only for tasks the actor can already read. {{issue}} is not visible to {{actor}}, so its comment, update, child, and assignment channels are all closed — the wall is visibility, not the write itself.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_not_visible_whoCanAct: {{assignee}}, and any agent or board member the task is visible to.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_not_visible_sanctione: Ask the board to widen visibility for {{actor}}, or create a child issue with the request in its description (issue creation is a separate, open write path) and let its assignee act.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_actor_class_excluded_: This actor class cannot write to tasks

Default-open issue writes are a standard-trust privilege. Low-trust, skill-test, and task-bridge scopes keep their existing tight walls, so {{actor}} cannot write to {{issue}} no matter who it acts for.
A standard-trust agent in this company, or a board member.
Report the request upward and let a standard-trust agent make the write — actor-class scope cannot be widened per task.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_responsible_user_ceil: This action was denied because {{responsible}} — the user this run acts on behalf of — does not have permission to perform it. The agent may be allowed, but a run can never exceed the permissions of the user it acts for, so the action is blocked. The write to {{issue}} was refused for that reason.
{{responsible}} once authorized, or anyone already permitted to write to {{issue}}.
Grant {{responsible}} the required permission, or have someone who is authorized take this action instead.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_responsible_user_unav: This run acts on behalf of {{responsible}}, but that account was removed or deactivated, so its permissions can no longer be evaluated. The agent's own permissions are not enough on their own — every action still requires an active responsible user. The write to {{issue}} was refused for that reason.
A board member, or {{actor}} once it has an active responsible user.
Mark the work blocked and reassign a responsible user (or reactivate the account) before the agent continues.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_assignee_run_lock_tit: Another agent's run owns this task
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_assignee_run_lock_des: {{assignee}} has {{issue}} checked out and a run is live. Checkout and run ownership stay assignee-scoped even though writes are open, so field edits belong to the run that holds the lock until it finishes.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_assignee_run_lock_who: {{assignee}}'s live run, or an agent holding the manage-active-checkouts permission.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_assignee_run_lock_san: Comment instead of patching — comments stay open and wake {{assignee}} — or wait for the run to release the lock and retry.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_cross_issue_influence_cap_exceede: This run has spent its cross-issue write budget

A single heartbeat run may make at most {{cap}} cross-issue comments or task updates combined. The cap bounds runaway comment sprays and loops — it is a rate backstop, not a permission decision, so {{actor}} is still allowed to write to {{issue}}.
{{actor}} on its next heartbeat run, or {{assignee}} on {{issue}} directly.
Consolidate what is left into one comment on your own task, or end the run and continue on the next heartbeat — the budget resets per run.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_cross_issue_influence_run_context: Cross-issue writes need a run to attribute them to

Every agent comment and task update is attributed to a heartbeat run so the cross-issue cap can be counted and the audit trail can name who acted for whom. This request arrived without a valid run, so it could not be contained.
{{actor}}, once the request carries its own run id.
Send the `X-Paperclip-Run-Id` header with your current run (`$PAPERCLIP_RUN_ID`) and retry.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_issue_write_attribution_spoof_rej: Responsible user cannot be chosen by the caller
`onBehalfOfUserId` is derived from the authenticated actor, never from the request body — an agent cannot pick the human whose authority it rides. The attempt was recorded in the audit log.
{{actor}} itself: the write is allowed, only the chosen attribution is not.
Remove `onBehalfOfUserId` from the request and retry; the server fills in {{responsible}} from your run.
taskUiFinalTail.denial_capWithAttempt_description: A single heartbeat run may make at most {{cap}} cross-issue comments or task updates combined; this was attempt {{count}}. The cap bounds runaway comment sprays and loops — it is a rate backstop, not a permission decision, so {{actor}} is still allowed to write to {{issue}}.
